reason: Egg can create signed HTTPS webhook channels with events and one project scope, but cannot select Discord, Slack, or email delivery, store a display name, or configure email recipients. The CLI's global --url option is reserved for the Egg server, so the command uses --webhook-url for its destination.

flags.name: email

flags.name: events
flags.description: Comma-separated events to deliver.

flags.name: project
flags.description: Project ID scope; repeat for additional projects.

reason: Egg's update endpoint only changes the webhook URL, event filter, and active state; it cannot change a display name, email recipients, or project scope. The shared CLI uses --webhook-url for the destination because --url is global, and requires --enabled true|false because --enabled is already value-typed for another command.
